messages:
samir: @olga heads-up — onboarding for Fjord Labs. Customer reports no API key visible in their console after SSO. I see the provisioner log shows a key created but it looks bound to an internal demo project. Can someone check?
provisioner-bot: Provisioner accepted claim for ext_tenant=fjord-oidc-321 at 2024-11-12T14:23:11Z. Created key=k_ABC*** (redacted) bound_to=proj-internal-fl-demo-452. Returned 200 to control-plane but UI surface call to /projects/proj-internal-fl-demo-452 returned 404 for customer query.
jess: hmm — could be the old demo org slug getting reused. We had a bug where a "factory reset" left tenant_mappings row behind.
lin: I can repro locally. Steps I ran: 
```
# repro (local)
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/provision -d '{"ext_tenant":"fjord-oidc-321","source":"okta","env":"prod"}' 
# provisioner accepts claim, creates key, binds to internal project
# check db:
SELECT * FROM tenant_mappings WHERE ext_id='fjord-oidc-321';
-- returns internal_project = 'proj-internal-fl-demo-452' (deleted flag = true)
```
olga: @lin can you try unlinking the mapping and repro the happy path so we can confirm manual fix for the customer?
lin: did that — after removing the mapping row and re-triggering the claim the provisioner created a new project proj-fjord-678 and the key surfaced in the customer's console. Manual steps I used:
- DELETE FROM tenant_mappings WHERE ext_id='fjord-oidc-321'
- curl -X POST ... (same as above)
- confirm project visible in UI and key present in customer console
jess: sounds like we should make provisioner prefer creating a new project if the mapped internal project has deleted=true or is in an internal-only namespace. Also add a safety check: if UI surface returns 404, fallback to create new project rather than binding silently.
samir: I'll tell the customer the workaround now and create a support ticket to track permanent fix.
samir: (to Fjord) Hi — we've repro'd the issue and created a fresh API key for your org. Please try the new key and confirm. Apologies for the churn.
provisioner-bot: action=unlink tenant_ext_id=fjord-oidc-321 actor=lin timestamp=2024-11-12T14:31:02Z
olga: filing INF-4521: provisioner should not rebind claims to deleted/internal demo projects. Assigning to @lin for fix and regression tests.
lin: taking INF-4521, will add unit/regression tests and a fallback path. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
samir: :thumbsup: I'll keep the support case open until Fjord confirms.
